parameters: \bStrength isn't the key for Pokémon.\nDo you understand this?
\bI'll show you how strategy can\nbeat brute strength.
\bSo, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!
\bSo, you mix brawn with brains?\nGood strategy!
\bFuchsia Gym is a tricked-up place.\nIt's riddled with invisible walls!
\bKoga might appear close, but he's\nblocked off.
\bYou have to find gaps in the walls\nto reach him.
\bIt's amazing how ninja can terrify,\neven now!
\bI was a magician once upon a time.
\bBut I dreamt of becoming a ninja,\nso I joined this Gym.
\bEven though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\nof Koga, my ninja master.
\bEven though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\nof Koga, my ninja master.
\bI like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!
\bI like poison and sleep techniques,\nas they linger after battle!
\bMaster Koga comes from a long line\nof ninjas.
EndSpeech: You're more skilled than I'd\nthought!
\bI also study the way of the ninja\nwith Master Koga!
\bNinja have a long history of using\nanimals!
\bA mere child like you dares to\nchallenge me?
\bThe very idea makes me shiver\nwith mirth!
\bVery well, I shall show you true\nterror as a ninja master.
\bPoison brings steady doom.\nSleep renders foes helpless.
\bDespair to the creeping horror of\nPoison-type Pokémon!

EndSpeech: Humph!
You have proven your worth!

Take the SOULBADGE!
\PN received the Soul Badge from Koga!
\bNow that you have the Soul Badge,\nthe Defense of your Pokémon rises.
\bIt also lets you Surf outside of\nbattle.
\bIt is a secret technique dating\nback some four hundred years.
\bWhen afflicted by Toxic, a Pokémon\nsuffers more and more.
\bIt suffers worsening damage as the\nbattle wears on!
\bThe famed invisible walls of\nFuchsia Gym have you frustrated?
\bLook very closely for gaps in the\ninvisible walls!
